replay.source:
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from graphlib import TopologicalSorter
from pathlib import Path

TASK = 'BFF-TEST-MIGRATION-SHARED-FOUNDATION-CONTRACT-CORRECTIVE-001'
DOC = 'docs/operations/bff-test-migration-repartition.md'
PART = 'docs/deployment/evidence/BFF-TEST-MIGRATION-REPARTITION-PLAN-001/partition.json'
EVIDENCE = f'docs/deployment/evidence/{TASK}/evidence.json'
BASE = 'e093ac6ccdd3b4c785da8d17154a34449b676a10'
ANCHOR = '322f43873af640d780032dab136a3cd007bdaa8d'
REMOVED = [f'services/control-plane/bff/tests/fixtures/{name}.py' for name in
           ['__init__', 'governance_fixture', 'research_fixture', 'training_fixture']]
NAMES = ['governance_fixture', 'research_fixture', 'training_fixture']
checks = []

def run(args, allowed=(0,)):
    p = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
    assert p.returncode in allowed, (args, p.returncode, p.stderr)
    checks.append({'argv': args, 'exit_code': p.returncode,
                   'terminal_output': p.stdout, 'terminal_stderr': p.stderr})
    return p

def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

def proof(data):
    return {'sha256': digest(data), 'bytes': len(data)}

old_bytes = {p: subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'{BASE}:{p}']) for p in (DOC, PART)}
before = json.loads(old_bytes[PART])
after = json.loads(Path(PART).read_bytes())
fixtures = before['shared_foundation_files']['shared_test_fixtures']
retained = [p for p in fixtures if p not in REMOVED]
expected = copy.deepcopy(before)
expected['shared_foundation_files']['shared_test_fixtures'] = retained
assert len(retained) == 4 and len(fixtures) == 8
assert after == expected, 'Partition contains changes outside the four fixture removals'
for p in REMOVED:
    assert f'- `{p}`' not in Path(DOC).read_text()
for p in retained:
    assert f'- `{p}`' in Path(DOC).read_text()

scans = []
for role, sha in [('reviewed_plan_document_anchor', ANCHOR),
                  ('dispatch_reviewed_anchor_and_fresh_origin_dev_base', BASE)]:
    paths = run(['git', 'ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', sha, '--', *REMOVED, *retained]).stdout.splitlines()
    assert set(paths) == set(retained)
    consumers = {}
    for name in NAMES:
        p = run(['git', 'grep', '-n', '-I', '-F', '-e', name, sha, '--', 'services/control-plane/bff/'], (1,))
        assert not p.stdout
        consumers[name] = {'count': 0, 'matches': []}
    scans.append({'role': role, 'commit': sha, 'absent_paths': REMOVED,
                  'present_paths': retained, 'literal_consumer_scan': consumers})

children = after['candidate_children']
files = [f for c in children for f in c['source_artifacts']]
assert len(children) == 18 and len(files) == len(set(files)) == 184
graph = {c['task_id']: set(c['depends_on_after_plan']) for c in children}
order = list(TopologicalSorter(graph).static_order())
b04 = next(c['task_id'] for c in children if c['order'] == 4)
consumers = [c['task_id'] for c in children if b04 in c['depends_on_after_plan']]
assert [c['order'] for c in children if c['task_id'] in consumers] == [8, 11, 12, 18]
assert all(order.index(b04) < order.index(c) for c in consumers)
assert len(after['shared_foundation_files']['retained_parent_paths']) == 3
run(['git', 'diff', '--check'])
changed = set(run(['git', 'diff', BASE, '--name-only']).stdout.splitlines())
untracked = set(run(['git', 'ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard']).stdout.splitlines())
assert changed | untracked in ({DOC, PART}, {DOC, PART, EVIDENCE})


print("PASS: absent fixtures, zero literal consumers, four retained files, unchanged 184-file/18-child partition, B04 dependencies and parent contract; scoped diff clean")
